name: Install ROS2 Dependencies
command: sudo apt-get install -y curl gnupg2 lsb-release

name: Add ROS2 GPG Key
command: sudo rm /usr/share/keyrings/ros2-archive-keyring.gpg && sudo curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ros2/ros2/humble/keys.asc | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/ros2-archive-keyring.gpg > /dev/null

name: Add ROS2 Repository
command: sudo echo 'Passwordless sudo is required for this script to work. Please configure your system to allow passwordless sudo for the user running the script.'
